name: reservedAnnotations1.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (x Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((C (mk-C (x Int)(z Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (y Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((D (mk-D (aobj Ref)(bobj Ref)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  (lift-C (sel-C C))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  (lift-D (sel-D D))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-C ((this Ref)) C
  (sel-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-D (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-D ((this Ref)) D
  (sel-D (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-A this)
    (deref-is-C this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-C this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-B this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-D this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class D:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for D.aobj: ---

(define-fun D!aobj ((this Ref)) Ref
  (aobj (deref-D this))
)

; --- getters for D.bobj: ---

(define-fun D!bobj ((this Ref)) Ref
  (bobj (deref-D this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-A A)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class C:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-C C)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-B B)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class D:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-D D)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun D.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-A (D!aobj this))
)

(assert (! (D.inv1 4) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun D.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-B (D!bobj this))
)

(assert (! (D.inv2 4) :named _xkassert1))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-A const-1-A))
        2 (lift-C const-2-C))
        3 (lift-B const-3-B))
        4 (lift-D const-4-D))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-3-B () B
  (mk-B 8))
(define-fun const-2-C () C
  (mk-C 5 6))
(define-fun const-1-A () A
  (mk-A 7))
(define-fun const-4-D () D
  (mk-D 2 3))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (aobj (sel-D (select heap 4))))))
  (or (is-lift-A a!1) (is-lift-C a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (bobj (sel-D (select heap 4))))))
  (is-lift-B a!1)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null) 1 (lift-A (mk-A 7)))
                  2
                  (lift-C (mk-C 5 6)))))
  (store (store a!1 3 (lift-B (mk-B 8))) 4 (lift-D (mk-D 2 3)))))
